requiredActions: Review every @Public annotation and document its reason.
Verify JWT_SECRET is mandatory in production startup configuration and rotate any default or exposed secret.
Verify organization membership and tenant context are validated on each protected data path.
Run build and live HTTP tests for missing, invalid, expired, and insufficient-role tokens plus cross-tenant read/write attempts.
